name: Enable S3 server access logging
description: Verify that server access logging is enabled for an S3 general purpose bucket.

remediation.summary: Configure S3 server access logging to an approved destination bucket.
remediation.rationale: Server access logs provide records of requests made to an S3 bucket and support security investigations and auditing.

potential_side_effects: Additional storage charges may accrue in the destination bucket.
Log delivery and retention require appropriate destination configuration.
Logging configuration changes may affect compliance and audit expectations.
preconditions: Verify the source bucket's live logging configuration.
Identify and approve a destination bucket in the same AWS Region.
Check destination bucket permissions and retention requirements.
Confirm the resource management mechanism before proposing changes.

validation.method: Read the live S3 bucket logging configuration.
success_criteria: The destination bucket and target prefix are recorded for review.

rollback.strategy: Restore the previously approved logging configuration through the established management mechanism.
rollback.warning: Do not disable existing logging automatically as a rollback without explicit security review and approval.
